# Pong Game

> A modern Python + Pygame reconstruction of the original 1972 Pong, built
> with accurate collision physics and performance-focused game loops.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Co-author: Mega Satish, ORCID 0000-0002-1844-9557
